summary: Frontend-only testing of Treesh single-file app (crossfade engine + Karaoke Fullscreen revamp). All advertised behaviors verified via Playwright on the public preview URL. Auto crossfade: main audio fades 0->1 while ghost ramps 1->0 and index advances. Manual crossfade: triggered by nextTrack(true) with explicit prep->fade phases and symmetric volume ramps (av 0->~0.7, gv ~1->0.7 over sampled window). Auto-mode manual Next does NOT crossfade (_xf stays null). Crossfade OFF (sec=0) persists in LS treesh_xf={sec:0,mode:'auto',last:6}, label shows 'Off', no fade near song end. Settings UI card data-testid=settings-crossfade present with default slider=6/label=6s (fresh LS), live label updates, mode buttons toggle aria-pressed. Settings Search returns 3 expected rows for 'crossfade'. Karaoke Fullscreen: all data-testids present (karaoke-fullscreen, kfs-title/artist, kfs-prev/play/next, kfs-progress, kfs-glow-accent/cover/rainbow, kfs-countin, kfs-exit), root class kfs kfs-g-<glow>, rainbow glow persists in treesh_kar_glow, kfs-idle class auto-applied after ~3s and removed on pointermove, exit button restores state.karFull=false and removes the FS root. Lyric line classes k-next/k-next2/active present (k-prev not yet present early in song, expected). Mobile 390x844: crossfade card fits (316px wide inside 390 viewport) and KFS top bar fits with title+glow-picker+countin+exit. IS_IOS note correctly absent on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is a single ~7600+ line file - continues to grow and should be split into modules for maintainability.
Tailwind is loaded from cdn.tailwindcss.com (production warning in console).
Top-level `let _xf` is script-scoped so not accessible on window; harmless but makes external instrumentation harder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL https://treesh-phase5.preview.emergentagent.com serves /app/single_html/index.html via static server on port 3000. No backend. Always set treesh_whatsnew_off and treesh_profile in LS and perform a user gesture (page.mouse.click) before calling audio.play(). Use playable song ids: black-barbie-bankrupt-freestyle, perfektenz-rippin-and-runnin, unique-carter-pink-sides, chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo (lyrics). _xf and _xfGhost are top-level `let` inside the main <script> block - they ARE accessible to page.evaluate as bare identifiers (not via window.*). Crossfade engine: xfBegin/xfCommit/xfTick/xfFinish at ~line 2178-2232. KFS at ~line 5325+ (renderKaraokeFS). Everything in current review passed; no action required.
